caption: The drawing displays two women’s bonnets positioned side by side, both rendered in soft, neutral tones. The bonnet on the left features a combination of beige and light brown shades, detailed with a wide, pale ribbon tied in a loose bow, lace trim around the face opening, and blue flowers with green leaves affixed to the left side. There is also a pale bow, possibly decorative, near the flowers. The bonnet on the right is similar in color—mainly beige—and also boasts lace trim and a wide ribbon bow, but does not have floral embellishments. Both bonnets are depicted with careful shading to suggest the texture and folds of fabric, and are set against an off-white background with no additional objects, emphasizing the details of the bonnets’ construction and decoration.
title: Bonnet
